description: Search canonical ammunition products and their current per-retailer offers. Results are descriptive only — prices, availability, $/round, observation time, and provenance, with no verdicts, scores, or recommendations. Use each offer's `outUrl` for outbound links (do not rewrite it). `sort` is a mechanical ordering, never a judgement.

inStock.description: When true, only products with in-stock offers are returned.

sort.description: Mechanical ordering only. Defaults to pricePerRoundAsc.

title: Search ammunition offers
